## Data

This assignment uses monthly sales (in millions of U.S. dollars) for jewelry stores (NAICS: 44831) from January 1993 through December 2004. The columns `t` (months), `years_elapsed` (years since December 1992, counted in monthly steps; this is not the calendar year), and `month` (a factor with January as the reference month) are created for you, just as in the lesson.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

jewelry_ts <- rio::import("https://byuistats.github.io/timeseries/data/retail_by_business_type.parquet") |>
  filter(naics == 44831) |>                                  # Jewelry stores
  mutate(date = yearmonth(as_date(month))) |>
  filter(date >= yearmonth("1993 Jan"), date <= yearmonth("2004 Dec")) |>
  mutate(
    t             = row_number(),                                    # time in months
    years_elapsed = t / 12,                                          # years since Dec 1992
    month         = factor(month.abb[month(date)], levels = month.abb) # January is the reference month
  ) |>
  select(date, t, years_elapsed, month, sales_millions) |>
  as_tsibble(index = date)
```
